about: Synthetic retrieval benchmark: student-style questions, written for this file (no founder's words), paraphrased away from the passages they ask for. expected: passages that answer (any of them counts; ids of packages/db/src/retrieval-benchmark/corpus.ts; play ids of packages/core/src/path/playbook); hardNegatives: passages on the same subject that do not answer; kind no_answer: nothing in the corpus answers (retrieval must be able to tell): small talk, personal matters, homework, sport, celebrities, coding help, other companies, campus logistics.
